description: This file contains the implementation of the Cookie controller class within the Opencart Catalog module. It manages cookie consent interactions, including displaying a cookie notice and handling user consent via AJAX.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing cookie consent display and user interactions within the Opencart catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and displays the cookie notification view if the user has not yet given consent, based on stored cookie settings and information.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes user permission to cookies via AJAX, sets a cookie accordingly, and returns a JSON response indicating success.
